text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: delayed token ingestion window on 2026-03-18 created ~142 impacted customers, some invoices already closed. Need a prioritized remediation checklist: determine who gets credits vs invoice adjustments, and an automated detector to prevent reoccurrence.

kevin: I'll take ownership of customer-facing comms + invoice decisioning. Plan: tier by token delta and dollar impact. ETA: initial email templates + decision matrix by Wed 2026-03-25.

hao: I'll own the ingest dedupe patch and the IDEMP tests. Aim to land a canary by Mon 2026-03-23 AM, full rollout Tuesday if green. I'll add a unit test for duplicate-event detection and an integration smoke to validate per-account token parity.

emily: For the backfill, I'll prepare the bucketed account CSV and run reconciliation in a safe sandbox. Need the export of affected rows (account_id, delta_tokens, current_invoice_amt, invoice_status). @billing-bot please export.

billing-bot: Export completed: /exports/2026-03-21/ingest_delta_2799999999.csv (rows:142). Fields: account_id, email, delta_tokens, est_credit_usd, invoice_id, invoice_status. SHA1: 7f6b3c9.

maria: Remediation matrix (sketch):
- delta_tokens < 10k -> auto credit, no invoice reissue
- 10k <= delta_tokens < 200k -> prefer credit, flag if invoice already paid
- delta_tokens >= 200k OR est_credit_usd > $800 -> manual review for invoice reissue
Owners: backfill/emails: emily; comms & final decision: kevin; policy exceptions: product@redwood.

kevin: QA gate: sample 30 accounts across each bucket. Reconcile expected vs applied credits before running broad backfill. Approve only after sampling passes.

hao: Hotfix branch pushed -> PR #4621. Noted some flaky CI in ingest integration (timing). Eng-sre canary scheduled.

eng-sre-bot: Canary scheduled: 5% traffic for 60m. Monitoring hooks: token-ingest-latency, duplicate-event-rate, ingestion-error-rate. Alert on duplicate-event-rate > 0.1% for 15m.

emily: Reconciliation snippet (sandbox):
```sql
-- compare expected tokens vs applied credits
WITH expected AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(expected_tokens) AS expected_tokens
  FROM expected_ingest
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-19'
  GROUP BY account_id
), applied AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(credited_tokens) AS credited_tokens
  FROM credits_audit
  WHERE credit_run_id = 'ingest_2799999999_backfill'
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT e.account_id, e.expected_tokens - COALESCE(a.credited_tokens,0) AS token_gap
FROM expected e
LEFT JOIN applied a USING (account_id)
ORDER BY token_gap DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
I'll push the sandbox job tonight and share results.

maria: Timeline recap:
- Hotfix canary: Mon 2026-03-23 AM (hao)
- Canary validation + roll: Tue 2026-03-24 COB (hao + eng-sre)
- Backfill sandbox & sample reconciliation: Wed 2026-03-25 AM (emily)
- Production backfill & credits run: Thu 2026-03-26 02:00-04:00 UTC (emily)
- Invoice reissue batch (manual review) + comms: Fri 2026-03-27 (kevin)

kevin: Draft comms plan: short email explaining root cause, what we corrected, and what customers see (credit or corrected invoice). Offer direct support contact for manual requests. Will post drafts here Thu AM.

hao: I'll add a continuous check to catch 'ingest_delay > 8h' aggregated over 10m windows and ship to #incidents. Query outline:
```sql
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS affected_accounts
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, MAX(processed_at - received_at) AS max_lag
  FROM ingest_events
  WHERE processed_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY account_id
) t
WHERE max_lag > 28800
GROUP BY region;
```
We'll tune thresholds after initial false-positive run.

emily: Policy note: for accounts with subscriptions/enterprise terms, route to account execs before issuing credits. I'll add a column in the CSV marking enterprise tags.

maria: I'll attach the postmortem doc to the linear ticket and add an RCA appendix with the dedupe stack trace and timeline. Also scheduling a 30m follow-up on Fri 2026-03-27 10:00 to review customer feedback after comms go out.

kevin: One operational ask: include a weekly digest in finance reports showing ingest lag spikes (past 30d) so we can identify recurring patterns. Tagging analytics for the dashboard.

emily: Confirmed. I'll add the weekly metric and a single-pane view for credits issued by root cause.

maria: Final note: be careful about double-crediting. Add idempotency token to credit-run job and require two approvers for runs that affect > $5k total credits.

hao: good call. I'll add idempotency and a pre-flight dry-run mode.

maria: Thanks everyone. Owners and dates noted. Meeting follow-ups scheduled. We'll update this thread with sample reconciliation results and the comms drafts. :white_check_mark:
